# Xbox

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Game-console marketing and store: dark 54px header, square lime CTA on green ink, yellow badges, Segoe UI, and a 4px-radius store module with a green Game Pass button.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (home, games, consoles, Game Pass, search, and one product page are public; Sign in, cart, BUY, and JOIN GAME PASS were not followed). Themes: light, dark.

Public signed-out surfaces of Xbox (xbox.com), captured 2026-11-19. `https://www.xbox.com/` redirected to `https://www.xbox.com/en-SG/`. No Microsoft sign-in, no cart, no card, no purchase.

The marketing site (home, games, consoles, Game Pass) is Microsoft Web Framework: dark 54px header `#1b1d1b`, square corners, lime CTA `#9bf00b` with green ink `#054b16`, Xbox green `#107c10`, yellow badges `#ffd800`, Segoe UI body and Segoe Pro Black on CTAs. Search and the store are a second module: 4px radius, Segoe UI, and on the product page a sampled green `#008746` GET GAME PASS and grey `#484e58` BUY. Computed styles came from the live T3 preview at 1169×731. Screenshots are headless Playwright at 1440×900 and 390×844 after the preview browser stopped producing frames.

## Typography

12 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Bahnschrift Light, Segoe UI, SegoeProBlack.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Segoe UI is the body stack (`"Segoe UI", SegoeUI, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`). CTAs and display headings use Segoe Pro Black (weight 900 on CTAs). The product title uses Bahnschrift Light. Both display families are Microsoft fonts and are not committed. Tokens fall back to Segoe UI, then Helvetica, then Arial.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Header side padding (58.4453px) is the 1169px preview, not the 1440 screenshot. Store green and buy grey are sampled from quantised PNGs, so a flat fill can be one step off the pre-quantise pixel (`#008746` and `#484e58` were read before quantise). Segoe Pro Black and Bahnschrift are named from `fontFamily` and are not in the package. The live hero CTA hover did not match the stylesheet hover colour. `--xds-*` radius tokens are declared in a store stylesheet but did not resolve on `:root` of the marketing home.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do use the lime CTA for marketing.** The home primary is `#9bf00b` with `#054b16` text and square corners. [home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png)
- **Do use Xbox green for secondary marketing text.** Lightweight CTAs measured `#107c10`. [games-light-desktop.png](screenshots/games-light-desktop.png)
- **Do use 4px radius on store cards and store buttons.** Search cards and the product buy bar are not square. [search-light-desktop.png](screenshots/search-light-desktop.png)
- **Don't round the marketing header, hero CTA, or badge.** Those computed to `0px`.
- **Don't send a visitor into sign-in or checkout from a specimen.** Sign in, Cart, BUY, and JOIN GAME PASS were measured and not followed.
